The design constraint that decides everything is that the record must one day be produced and understood by someone who was not in the room and has no reason to believe the agent - so each artifact must be self-explanatory, timestamped, hard to alter after the fact, and linked to the specific outreach it authorized. Retention periods and recording obligations differ across the consent regimes and by carrier and change between plan years; verify the current requirements rather than adopting a remembered duration.

included: one retrievable store for permission artifacts, suppression status, scope agreements, and required recordings
self-explanatory, timestamped, tamper-evident artifact design
retention as a verified obligation class
excluded: the complete client file standard, which composes these records with materials and notes and is its own unit
privacy and data-protection handling of the stored content, which is its own unit
service-call records over the life of a client, which belong to the sibling renewal knowledge base

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a change in recording or retention obligations, or a system migration that threatens continuity of the stored artifacts

pros.claim: A single retrievable store collapses the worst audit scenario, hunting for evidence across systems while a response clock runs
pros.example: answering a carrier question about one contact with a dated permission artifact and its call recording in a single search

pros.claim: Linking each artifact to the outreach it authorized makes the permission scope enforceable in practice rather than in principle
pros.example: the dialer refusing a number whose stored permission covers a different product class

cons.claim: Capture discipline competes directly with conversation quality, since the record is created while a person is waiting
cons.example: pausing a warm first call to note the permission source and channel before continuing

cons.claim: Retention obligations and recording storage accumulate cost and privacy exposure that grow with the book
cons.example: years of call recordings that must be kept, secured, and eventually disposed of on schedule

failure_modes: permission recorded in a note field with no source, channel, or date
recordings held only in a vendor or dialer system the agent will lose access to when the contract ends
suppression checked once at import and never re-checked before later campaigns
retention allowed to run past or fall short of the applicable obligation because the duration was never verified
acceptance_tests: a randomly selected recent contact can be traced end to end from permission artifact to outreach to any required recording within minutes
retention settings for each artifact class cite the obligation they implement and the date that obligation was verified
revisit_triggers: a recording or retention obligation changes
the practice changes dialer, customer-record, or storage systems
a vendor relationship ends and its held records must be migrated

nodes.definition: Handle the health and identity data this business unavoidably touches - Medicare identifiers, medication lists, provider names, conditions mentioned in passing during a needs conversation - under a minimum-necessary discipline rather than collecting whatever is convenient. Operationally that means collecting only what the current task requires and not retaining screenshots or notes beyond it, storing records in access-controlled systems rather than personal devices, car folders, and home paper piles, transmitting through channels the carrier permits rather than ordinary email or messaging, disposing on a defined schedule rather than never, and having a written response path ready for the day a laptop, a phone, or a paper file goes missing. Which obligations apply to a given agent or agency arrangement is genuinely situation-specific: federal health-privacy rule classes, state personal-information and breach-notification statutes, and carrier data-handling terms may each apply, and the answer is verified with counsel and each carrier rather than assumed from what other agents do.

included: minimum-necessary collection and retention discipline
storage, transmission, and disposal controls
incident response readiness for lost or exposed records
excluded: determining which specific statutes apply to a particular agency arrangement, which is a question for counsel
clinical interpretation of any health information collected
the file completeness standard, which is its own unit

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a privacy or breach-notification rule change, a carrier data-handling amendment, or an incident that shows the current controls are insufficient

pros.claim: Collecting less means a smaller blast radius on the day something is lost, which is the only control that always works
pros.example: an incident involving a device that never stored identifiers because the workflow kept them in the access-controlled system

pros.claim: Written incident response converts a panicked week into a procedure with the notification questions already framed for counsel
pros.example: a misplaced folder handled in a day with a documented scope assessment rather than an improvised guess

cons.claim: Minimum-necessary discipline fights the natural workflow of an agent who wants everything about a client at hand in the field
cons.example: not carrying printed drug lists to a home appointment and working from an access-controlled device instead

cons.claim: Determining which obligations actually apply requires counsel time an independent agent is reluctant to spend
cons.example: paying for an opinion on the practice's status under health-privacy rules before any incident has occurred

failure_modes: identifiers and drug lists living in personal messaging apps, unencrypted email, or a car folder
keeping data indefinitely because no disposal schedule was ever set
improvising after a loss instead of following a written response path
assuming the practice falls outside every privacy obligation because no one has ever said otherwise
acceptance_tests: a data map lists what identifying and health data is collected, where it lives, who can reach it, and when it is disposed of
a written incident response path exists naming the first actions, the assessment questions, and who is contacted
revisit_triggers: a state or federal privacy or breach-notification obligation changes
the practice adds staff, a subcontractor, or a new storage or transmission tool
any loss, exposure, or near-miss occurs

nodes.definition: Define one standard for what a complete prospect or client file contains and hold every file to it while it is being created, never retroactively: the permission artifact and its source, the scope agreement, the materials actually presented with their approval identifiers and plan-year versions, notes recording the needs discussion and the beneficiary's own stated reasons in their own words, the disclosures given, any accommodation offered to a vulnerable consumer or representative present, the ready-to-sell evidence for the product written, and the submission confirmation. The operating test is retrieval under pressure rather than existence: a named file produced complete within the window a carrier request allows, by whoever is at the desk that day. The standard exists because of one asymmetry that governs this whole vertical - in an audit, a secret shop, or a complaint investigation, a compliant act with no documentation and an actual violation are indistinguishable, so undocumented good practice provides no protection at all.

included: the enumerated contents of a complete file
creation-time discipline rather than retroactive assembly
the timed retrieval test as the definition of done
excluded: the plan-comparison worksheet content itself, which belongs to the sibling enrollment knowledge base
ongoing service and annual-review records, which belong to the sibling renewal knowledge base
asserting a specific retention duration or response window as fact

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: an audit or carrier request reveals a missing element class, or the required contents change with a rule or policy revision

pros.claim: A creation-time standard means an audit is a retrieval exercise rather than a reconstruction project
pros.example: responding to a carrier request the same day with a complete file rather than spending a week assembling one

pros.claim: Recording the beneficiary's own stated reasons is the strongest available evidence that the comparison was need-driven and not compensation-driven
pros.example: notes quoting the beneficiary explaining why keeping a particular clinic mattered more than a lower premium

cons.claim: Full documentation adds real minutes to every appointment and is the first thing sacrificed when a season gets busy
cons.example: a peak-week appointment where notes are shortened to a line and the accommodation offered is never recorded

cons.claim: A single standard applied to every file over-documents the simple cases while still being thin for the complicated ones
cons.example: the same checklist for a straightforward routine enrollment and for a contested household with a representative involved

failure_modes: assembling files after a request arrives rather than at the time of the work
notes recording the agent's conclusion instead of the beneficiary's own words and stated reasons
materials referenced by name with no approval identifier or plan-year version
files complete but scattered, so retrieval takes longer than the response window allows
acceptance_tests: a random sample of recent files each contains every enumerated element with dates and identifiers present
a timed retrieval drill produces a named complete file well inside the shortest response window the practice is subject to
revisit_triggers: a carrier or regulator requests a file and something required is missing
the required file contents change with a rule or carrier policy revision
staff, systems, or the volume of the book changes

nodes.definition: Have the response path built before it is needed, because allegations arrive without warning and the response window starts immediately. The work begins with recognizing the channels: a carrier referral originating from a beneficiary complaint made to the plan or to Medicare, a state insurance department inquiry, a carrier secret-shop or call-monitoring finding, an upline escalation, or simply a family member's angry phone call. Then a fixed sequence - triage on a same-day clock, pull the file rather than reconstruct from memory, answer factually and within the carrier's stated window without arguing with the beneficiary or their family, and where the beneficiary's situation can still be corrected, correct it first and settle the question of fault afterwards. The closing step is the one agents skip: record the root cause and the specific practice change it produced, so the same allegation cannot arrive twice. Self-reporting duties, response windows, and the consequences of a late or missing response are carrier- and state-specific and must be verified in the contract and in current rules.

included: allegation arrival channels and same-day triage
file-based factual response inside the stated window
beneficiary-first correction and root-cause closure
excluded: legal defence strategy or any response to litigation, which belongs to counsel
routine service issues raised by satisfied clients, which belong to the sibling renewal knowledge base
asserting a specific response window as fact

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a carrier or state changes response windows or self-reporting duties, or an allegation arrives through a channel the current path does not monitor

pros.claim: A pre-built path removes panic from the first hours, which is when most damage is done by an improvised or defensive reply
pros.example: a same-day acknowledgement and a factual file-based response instead of a week of silence followed by an argument

pros.claim: Correcting the beneficiary's situation first usually shrinks the matter, because most complaints are about a consequence rather than about the agent
pros.example: helping a beneficiary who misunderstood a coverage change reach the right resolution path before the fault question is even reached

cons.claim: Responding factually without defending oneself feels unjust when the allegation is inaccurate
cons.example: answering a claim about something never said with only what the file shows, and letting the record speak

cons.claim: Each allegation consumes disproportionate time in the busiest weeks, and there is no way to defer it
cons.example: a response window landing in the middle of the peak season and taking a full day out of it

failure_modes: missing a response window because the notification went to an unmonitored channel
reconstructing events from memory when a file already contains the answer
arguing with a beneficiary or a family member instead of answering the carrier factually
closing a matter without recording the root cause, so the same failure recurs
acceptance_tests: every allegation received in the current plan year has a dated triage record, a response, and a closed root-cause entry naming the practice change
the notification channels for every carrier and the state are monitored and named in the response path
revisit_triggers: a carrier changes its response window, self-reporting duty, or notification channel
two allegations share a root cause
an allegation reveals a channel the response path does not cover

nodes.definition: Run compliance as a recurring internal review rather than an annual scramble, on a cadence matched to how the practice actually decays: a pre-season readiness sweep before selling authority starts to matter, a sampled file review at a fixed interval through the peak weeks, periodic self-monitoring of recorded calls against the prohibited-practice catalog, a purge-and-refresh pass over every public asset at each plan-year boundary, and a written remediation log in which each finding is closed by a named change on a dated line rather than by an intention. The cadence exists because the whole stack decays continuously and invisibly - rules are re-issued, a certification lapses, a vendor changes a capture page, an old flyer reappears in a rack, a habit slips under seasonal pressure - and because a documented history of finding and fixing one's own problems is the most persuasive evidence of good faith available on the day something does go wrong.

included: the pre-season sweep, in-season file sampling, and call self-monitoring
the plan-year purge of public assets
a remediation log that closes findings with a named change and date
excluded: external carrier or regulator audits, which are responded to rather than scheduled
annual client review meetings, which belong to the sibling renewal knowledge base
financial or production performance review, which is a business rather than compliance activity

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a recurring finding, an external audit result, or a change in the practice's footprint shows the current cadence or sampling coverage is inadequate

pros.claim: Finding one's own problems first is both cheaper and materially more credible than having a carrier find them
pros.example: discovering a scope-agreement gap in a sampled file review and correcting the intake habit before any carrier request arrives

pros.claim: A dated remediation log turns good intentions into evidence and stops the same finding recurring every year
pros.example: a log line showing the intake form was changed on a date after a sampling miss, with the next sample clean

cons.claim: Self-audit time is taken from selling time in exactly the weeks when selling time is worth the most
cons.example: an afternoon of file sampling during the busiest fortnight of the season

cons.claim: Self-auditing one's own work has a blind spot that no cadence removes, since the reviewer shares the habits being reviewed
cons.example: repeatedly passing a defect in one's own intake process because it looks normal to the person who created it

failure_modes: scheduling the cadence and then skipping it precisely when the season makes it most necessary
logging findings without a named change and a date, so nothing is actually closed
sampling only easy files and never the complicated ones where defects concentrate
letting the plan-year purge slip so prior-year assets stay in circulation
acceptance_tests: the remediation log shows every finding from the current plan year closed with a named change and a date, or explicitly carried with a reason
the pre-season sweep, at least one in-season file sample, and the plan-year purge are each recorded as completed with their dates
revisit_triggers: a finding recurs after being logged as closed
an external audit or complaint surfaces something the cadence should have caught
the practice adds staff, carriers, states, or channels that the current sweep does not cover

edges.why_related: the dominance gate can only classify a tactic once the rule layers and their locators are mapped
the protected-population duty is assembled from federal marketing rules, state conduct rules, and carrier policy that the map names
the education boundary is drawn where it is because the audience is a protected population that must decide for itself
carriers gate certification on an active producer licence, so licensure precedes the annual training project
carrier appointment and selling authority attach to a completed current-year certification
the hierarchy and release question only exists once a contract is being written through an upline
contract in good standing and an in-force appointment are inputs to the carrier's ready-to-sell finding
which consent regimes stack on a given outreach channel is read off the rule-layer map
a personal appointment can only be scoped once permission to make contact exists at all
the catalog is the list the dominance gate checks a proposed tactic against
a piece is drafted against the prohibition and conditional lists before it is ever submitted for approval
an event cannot be advertised until its advertisement has been classified and cleared through the review path
a plan-presenting sales event requires verified selling authority for every product presented
a vendor's capture page, advertisement, and script are marketing material that must survive the same classification and disclosure test
online assets are marketing material first and are only then subject to the extra online-specific problems
purchased leads can only be scored and placed in the mix after their inherited obligations are understood
a recurring community presence is a series of events and inherits the event class rules entirely
the record system exists to store and make retrievable exactly the permission artifacts this regime requires
what is stored determines what must be protected, transmitted carefully, and disposed of on schedule
the permission and recording artifacts are required elements of a complete file
a factual response inside a short window is only possible when the file already exists and is retrievable
the file standard is the benchmark a sampled self-review measures files against
no channel may enter the mix unless it can produce the permission artifact the dominance gate requires, whatever its yield
pacing, comprehension, and no-pressure duties bound how a community session may invite contact or capture sign-ins
superlatives, implied endorsement, and health-status targeting are prohibited online exactly as they are offline
the education boundary decides what may be said from the front of a room and keeps an educational event inside its class
minimum-necessary and transmission rules bound what consumer data a lead vendor arrangement may collect, share, or hand back
pipeline pressure pushes toward the highest-yield channels, several of which sit on or across the prohibition line
edges.resolution_rule: the catalog wins without exception: a channel that requires a prohibited or conditionally-noncompliant practice is dropped and the volume gap is filled from an approved source, never by relaxing the catalog

edges.why_related: the upline offering the most support is often the one whose release policy most restricts future mobility, while the most portable arrangement offers the least help
edges.resolution_rule: decide by the release policy first because mobility is irreversible once signed, and buy the missing support separately; only accept a restrictive release where the support is contractual and named rather than promised

edges.why_related: an audience that has come to trust the agent wants plan specifics, which the educational event class forbids in the room
edges.resolution_rule: split rather than blend: keep the educational session inside its class and run a separately advertised and reported marketing event, or an individual appointment with its own scope agreement, for the plan-specific discussion

edges.why_related: self-audit consumes exactly the peak-season hours that the pipeline is competing for
edges.resolution_rule: protect a reduced but non-zero in-season sample rather than deferring the cadence entirely, and move the heavy sweeps to the pre-season and post-season windows where they do not compete with selling time

edges.why_related: most allegations that reach a carrier trace back to a specific catalog item performed under pressure rather than to a novel failure
vendor-sourced contacts generate a disproportionate share of allegations because the consumer never recognizes the request the vendor recorded
a lapsed licence or missed continuing-education deadline silently flips a carrier's selling-authority finding to false without any other visible change
certification season must close before the event calendar for the plan year can be committed to venues and reported to carriers
spending on leads for a carrier or state the agent is not yet authorized to sell wastes both the spend and the consumer's time
the plan-year purge and asset inventory feed back into which templates are re-submitted, retired, or rebuilt
each root cause closed adds or sharpens a catalog entry so the same allegation cannot arrive from the same gap twice
both are bounded consent artifacts with a scope, a date, and an expiry, and agents routinely conflate them and assume one satisfies the other

conflict_axes.name: compliance_certainty_vs_growth_speed
conflict_axes.description: Every unproven tactic promises volume now and evidence later, while the dominance gate insists the evidence be designed before the tactic runs; in a seasonal business the cost of waiting is concentrated into a few weeks.
poles: run the tactic now and document afterwards
prove the tactic compliant and evidenced before it runs
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the gate always wins on activity that touches a consumer; speed is recovered by pre-approving a library of tactics and templates in the off-season so the in-season answer is already yes

conflict_axes.name: carrier_breadth_vs_certification_load
conflict_axes.description: Serving a county's real plan landscape argues for many carrier contracts, but every added carrier multiplies annual modules, portals, marketing policies, and status checks that one person must complete before a fixed deadline.
poles: contract broadly to serve every local need
contract narrowly to finish certification and maintain quality
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: size the portfolio to what can be certified and maintained with margin, chosen by which networks and needs actually appear in the agent's counties, and disclose honestly which carriers are represented

conflict_axes.name: upline_support_vs_contract_mobility
conflict_axes.description: The hierarchy that supplies certification help, leads, and material review is typically the one whose release policy makes leaving expensive, while an easily exited arrangement usually supplies little.
poles: maximize upline support and accept lock-in
maximize contract mobility and self-supply support
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: treat release policy as the irreversible term and support as a purchasable one; accept restrictive release only where the support is named in the contract rather than promised in a meeting

conflict_axes.name: education_reach_vs_personal_advice
conflict_axes.description: The most useful thing an audience wants is a direct answer about their own situation, and the compliant answer in a public setting is always a mechanism plus an invitation to a private conversation.
poles: answer the person in front of the room
teach the mechanism and route the person to a private appointment
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: answer mechanisms publicly and situations privately, with a rehearsed redirect that respects the asker rather than deflecting them

conflict_axes.name: lead_volume_vs_inherited_liability
conflict_axes.description: Purchased leads fill a calendar on demand, which no organic channel does, and they import consent provenance and advertising conduct the agent did not perform and cannot fully observe.
poles: buy volume and manage the exposure
generate slower and own the provenance
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: buy only where the capture page, verbatim consent language, and resale representation are in hand and stored, and cap dependence so no vendor failure can end the season

conflict_axes.name: responsiveness_vs_permission_limits
conflict_axes.description: A prospect who reaches out once and goes quiet is commercially valuable and legally fenced; the responsive instinct is to follow up, and the permission may have lapsed or never covered that channel or product.
poles: follow up while interest is warm
honour the recorded scope and expiry of the permission
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the recorded artifact governs; re-invite contact through a compliant channel rather than stretching a lapsed or differently-scoped permission

conflict_axes.name: documentation_burden_vs_appointment_flow
conflict_axes.description: Complete files are built at the moment of the conversation, and every element captured takes attention away from a person who is trying to understand a consequential choice.
poles: keep the conversation flowing and write it up later
capture each required element as it happens
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: capture at the time but design the capture to be short and structured, so completeness costs minutes rather than attention, and never write a file up from memory

conflict_axes.name: beneficiary_autonomy_vs_caregiver_control
conflict_axes.description: A family member is often the one who called, organizes the appointment, and has strong views, while the decision and the signature belong to the beneficiary, whose own preferences may differ.
poles: work through the engaged family member
keep the beneficiary as the decision-maker
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the beneficiary decides unless documented legal authority says otherwise; the family member is welcomed as support and the beneficiary's own restatement of the choice is what goes in the file

conflict_axes.name: season_selling_time_vs_self_audit_time
conflict_axes.description: The weeks when compliance drift is fastest are the weeks when every hour has the highest selling value, so the review most needed is the review most easily postponed.
poles: sell through the season and audit afterwards
hold the review cadence through the peak
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: move heavy sweeps into the pre-season and post-season and protect a small, fixed in-season sample that is never cancelled, so drift is detected while it is still cheap

conflict_axes.name: data_utility_vs_minimum_necessary
conflict_axes.description: Rich records about medications, providers, and household circumstances make service better and make an incident worse, and the same detail that helps a comparison expands the exposure the practice carries.
poles: keep everything that helps serve the client
collect and retain only what the task requires
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: collect what the current task needs into access-controlled storage, dispose on a defined schedule, and keep identifiers out of field devices and informal channels entirely

edge_cases.description: A prospect returns a voicemail left months earlier and now asks about a different product class than the one they originally requested information about
edge_cases.trigger: an inbound call whose stored permission is stale and scoped to another product
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the inbound call as permission for the question they asked today, capture a fresh permission and a new scope agreement for anything beyond it, and record the change of scope rather than relying on the original record

edge_cases.description: A carrier certification module is failed near the deadline and the retake waiting period runs past the carrier's cutoff
edge_cases.trigger: an attempt limit or waiting period collides with a certification deadline
edge_cases.mitigation: stop all activity for that carrier immediately, confirm the waiting period and any appeal path with the carrier in writing, redirect the season's pipeline to certified carriers, and disclose plainly to prospects that this carrier cannot be presented this year

edge_cases.description: An adult child calls to enroll a parent who is not on the line and for whom no documented authority exists
edge_cases.trigger: a third party attempts to make an enrollment decision for a beneficiary
edge_cases.mitigation: decline to proceed without the beneficiary present or documented legal authority, offer to schedule a conversation including both, and record the request, the refusal, and the reason in the file

edge_cases.description: At a community education session an attendee asks in front of the room which plan they personally should take given their medications
edge_cases.trigger: an individual situation is raised publicly during an educational event
edge_cases.mitigation: answer only the mechanism the question touches, offer a private appointment with its own scope agreement, and note in the event record that no plan-specific recommendation was given

edge_cases.description: A purchased lead turns out to have been sold to several agents and the verbatim consent language does not match what the vendor described
edge_cases.trigger: vendor diligence at or after purchase contradicts the vendor's representation
edge_cases.mitigation: quarantine the batch and stop calling it, seek the actual capture artifacts, treat any contact already made as a potential complaint source and document it, and remove or suspend the vendor from the mix

edge_cases.description: A prior-year flyer reappears in a pharmacy rack after the plan year has rolled over
edge_cases.trigger: an uncontrolled distribution point retains superseded material
edge_cases.mitigation: retrieve and replace immediately, add the venue to the distribution inventory so the plan-year purge covers it, and record the incident in the remediation log with the inventory change

edge_cases.description: A non-resident licence lapses mid-season while the pipeline already contains residents of that state
edge_cases.trigger: a renewal or continuing-education deadline is missed in a secondary state
edge_cases.mitigation: stop all activity involving that state at once, pursue reinstatement through the state's own process, notify affected carriers as the contract requires, and hand affected prospects a plain explanation and an alternative path rather than leaving them stranded

edge_cases.description: A carrier secret-shop or monitored call captures a casual superlative such as a claim that a plan is the best available
edge_cases.trigger: conversational habit collides with the prohibition on superlatives and implied endorsement
edge_cases.mitigation: acknowledge factually, correct the language in scripts and training, add the phrase to the self-monitoring checklist, and log the root cause with the specific wording change adopted

edge_cases.description: A beneficiary showing signs of confusion insists on signing today and becomes upset when the agent proposes to pause
edge_cases.trigger: capacity doubt collides with the beneficiary's own expressed urgency
edge_cases.mitigation: stop the enrollment, explain plainly that the decision deserves a second conversation, offer to reconvene with a trusted person present, note what was observed factually without diagnosing, and record the accommodation offered

edge_cases.description: An upline offers a lead programme that requires using a script and landing page the agent has not seen reviewed
edge_cases.trigger: an attractive programme arrives with unreviewed marketing material attached
edge_cases.mitigation: request the approval identifiers and the capture artifacts before participating, run the programme through the tactic gate, and decline until the material's review status and consent provenance are documented

edge_cases.description: A satisfied client posts a public thank-you naming a specific plan on the agent's social page, and other followers reply asking whether they should switch to it
edge_cases.trigger: user-generated content turns a general profile into a plan-specific promotional thread
edge_cases.mitigation: do not amplify or endorse the plan-specific content, reply with a mechanism-level note and an invitation to a private conversation, apply the platform's own comment policy consistently, and archive the thread and the action taken

edge_cases.description: A scheduled appointment slips across the plan-year boundary, leaving the scope agreement and the presentation materials dated to the prior year
edge_cases.trigger: a rescheduled meeting crosses a plan-year change
edge_cases.mitigation: re-paper the scope agreement under the current plan year, replace every material with the current-year approved version, and note in the file why both versions exist

workflow.action: Map the governing rule layers and locate the current-year text of each
workflow.description: List every activity class the practice performs and name the federal, state, carrier, and upline rule that governs it, with a locator and the date the text was read
workflow.artifact: layered rule map with per-obligation locators and verification dates
workflow.gate: every activity class names its governing layer, a locator, and a verification date inside the current plan year

workflow.action: Install the compliance-dominance gate for new tactics
workflow.description: Write the one-paragraph pre-approval format that names the rule class touched, the artifact that will exist afterwards, and the approver, plus the abandon-and-substitute path
workflow.artifact: tactic pre-approval format and decision log
workflow.gate: the log format is in use and no live tactic lacks an entry

workflow.action: Set the vulnerable-consumer contact and capacity standard
workflow.description: Write the pacing, accommodation, authority-verification, comprehension-check, and hard-stop rules and the banned pressure tactics before any prospect is contacted
workflow.artifact: consumer-protection contact standard and hard-stop rule
workflow.gate: the standard names who may sign, what accommodation is offered and recorded, and the exact condition that stops an interaction

workflow.action: Secure and calendar every licence in the footprint
workflow.description: Obtain or confirm resident and non-resident licences and load every renewal and continuing-education date into one calendar with lead time
workflow.artifact: footprint licence and continuing-education calendar with stored state lookups
workflow.gate: every state shows a current verified status and a scheduled reminder ahead of its deadline

workflow.action: Complete the annual certification project in dependency order
workflow.description: Finish the shared annual training first, then carrier product modules ordered by how much of the book depends on each carrier, storing evidence per carrier
workflow.artifact: per-carrier certification tracker with stored completion evidence
workflow.gate: the shared training precedes every carrier module and each contracted carrier shows a passed current-year status with evidence stored

workflow.action: Assemble the carrier contract stack and confirm coverage and release terms
workflow.description: Submit contracting packages, obtain appointments and writing numbers per state and product, confirm errors-and-omissions coverage, and read the charge-back, agent-of-record, marketing, and self-reporting clauses
workflow.artifact: contract register with clause summaries, coverage evidence, and written release policies
workflow.gate: no contract is submitted before its release policy and its conduct clauses are recorded in writing

workflow.action: Build and verify the ready-to-sell matrix
workflow.description: Consolidate carrier, state, and product selling authority into one matrix verified from each carrier portal, with a stored dated export and a same-day re-check habit
workflow.artifact: ready-to-sell matrix with dated portal evidence
workflow.gate: no marketing or enrollment activity exists for any carrier, state, or product whose authority is unverified

workflow.action: Write the prohibited-practice catalog and rehearse it
workflow.description: Separate absolute prohibitions from conditional permissions, store each condition beside its practice with its verification date, and rehearse the responses that pressure situations require
workflow.artifact: prohibition and conditional-permission catalog with verification dates
workflow.gate: every conditional entry carries its current-year condition and the date it was verified

workflow.action: Classify, review, and version all public material
workflow.description: Classify each piece as plan-specific or general, submit what requires approval with real lead time, apply the disclosure classes, and mark every piece with its plan year
workflow.artifact: approved template library and circulating-material inventory
workflow.gate: no piece is in public circulation without its classification, disclosures, plan-year marker, and approval identifier where required

workflow.action: Stand up the permission capture and record system
workflow.description: Define what artifact each channel must produce, wire capture into the record system with source, channel, scope and date, and add suppression and do-not-call checks before any campaign
workflow.artifact: permission capture standard wired into a single retrievable record store
workflow.gate: a sampled recent contact traces to a stored artifact naming its product scope, channel, source, and date

workflow.action: Compose the compliant lead-source portfolio and the event calendar
workflow.description: Score each candidate source by exposure, permission artifact, and survivability, vet vendors before purchase, book the educational and marketing events with their carrier reporting, and set the substitution plan for each source
workflow.artifact: lead-source register with per-source scoring, vendor files, and a reported event calendar
workflow.gate: every active source has a stored permission-artifact description and a named substitute, and no single source would stop the practice if it disappeared

workflow.action: Set the file standard and the recurring self-audit and allegation cadence
workflow.description: Enumerate what a complete file contains, run the timed retrieval drill, and schedule the pre-season sweep, in-season sampling, plan-year purge, and the allegation triage path with its monitored channels
workflow.artifact: file standard checklist, retrieval drill result, audit calendar, and remediation log
workflow.gate: a randomly named file is produced complete inside the shortest applicable response window and the audit calendar and allegation path are scheduled with owners

priority_rationale: The frame units come first because nothing downstream can be decided without knowing which rule layer governs an activity, that compliance outranks growth when they collide, that the audience is a protected population, and where education stops and personal advice begins; the credentialing chain follows in strict order because a licence gates certification, certification gates contracting and appointment, and all three composite into the ready-to-sell status that is the hard gate on every consumer-facing act; the marketing-rule units then bound what may be said, sent, and hosted once selling authority exists; lead generation is deliberately placed after those bounds so channels are built inside the rules rather than retrofitted to them; and the documentation and audit-readiness units come last because they compose everything above into files, records, and a recurring review loop that is what actually survives a carrier audit, a secret shop, or a complaint investigation.

dominance_rules.rule: A compliance obligation dominates any growth tactic it collides with
dominance_rules.rationale: this is the most regulated vertical in the practice set, where one prohibited tactic can end carrier contracts and licensure while a lost month only costs a month
dominance_rules.trigger: a prospecting, marketing, event, or partnership idea cannot be run in a form that satisfies a named obligation
dominance_rules.action: drop or redesign the tactic, record the decision, and fill the gap from an already-approved source

dominance_rules.rationale: activity without selling authority voids compensation, harms the beneficiary whose enrollment may be invalid, and triggers carrier action
dominance_rules.trigger: an appointment, event, or campaign involves a carrier, state, or product whose authority is unverified or lapsed
dominance_rules.action: stop that activity until the carrier portal confirms authority, and redirect the prospect to a carrier that is verified

dominance_rules.rationale: the population is protected and vulnerable, and an enrollment the beneficiary did not understand is a harm first and a complaint second
dominance_rules.trigger: capacity, comprehension, or signing authority is in genuine doubt at any point
dominance_rules.action: stop the interaction, offer to reconvene with a trusted person or documented representative, and record what was observed and offered without diagnosing

dominance_rules.rule: The strictest applicable rule layer dominates the most permissive
dominance_rules.rationale: federal, state, carrier, and upline rules overlap without a single hierarchy, and satisfying the strictest satisfies all of them
dominance_rules.trigger: two governing layers permit different conduct for the same activity
dominance_rules.action: follow the strictest reading and record which layers were compared and why

dominance_rules.rule: Written current-year rule text dominates any verbal assurance
dominance_rules.rationale: uplines, peers, and memory all describe prior-year rules with complete confidence, and only the text has a date
dominance_rules.trigger: a claimed rule cannot be traced to a locator in the current plan year
dominance_rules.action: suspend the activity until the text is located and read, then record the locator in the rule map

dominance_rules.rule: A documented permission dominates a remembered one
dominance_rules.rationale: an artifact is the only form of permission that exists for an auditor or a complaint reviewer
dominance_rules.trigger: outreach is contemplated where no stored artifact covers that person, product type, and channel
dominance_rules.action: do not make contact; re-invite permission through a compliant channel and store the new artifact

dominance_rules.rule: Need-driven comparison dominates compensation in every plan presentation
dominance_rules.rationale: compensation is set by regulated schedules and steering by it corrupts the only thing the beneficiary is relying on
dominance_rules.trigger: a carrier, product, or ordering would be chosen or emphasized for what it pays
dominance_rules.action: present according to the documented need and record the beneficiary's own stated reasons in the file

dominance_rules.rule: Current-plan-year approved material dominates convenient material
dominance_rules.rationale: superseded pieces misstate benefits to a consumer and are indefensible in review even when the error is innocent
dominance_rules.trigger: an unapproved or prior-year piece is the only thing at hand for an appointment, a rack, or a post
dominance_rules.action: use nothing rather than the superseded piece, and pull the outdated item from circulation the same day

dominance_rules.rule: Correcting the beneficiary's situation dominates defending the agent's position
dominance_rules.rationale: most allegations concern a consequence the beneficiary is still living with, and correction shrinks the matter while argument enlarges it
dominance_rules.trigger: an allegation or complaint arrives and a correction path for the beneficiary still exists
dominance_rules.action: pursue the correction first, answer the carrier factually from the file, and settle fault afterwards

dominance_rules.rationale: identity and health data cannot be un-exposed, and the only reliably effective control is holding less of it in fewer places
dominance_rules.trigger: a workflow would copy identifiers or health details into a personal device, an informal channel, or an unmanaged file
dominance_rules.action: keep the data in the access-controlled system, transmit only through permitted channels, and dispose on the defined schedule

anti_rework_rules.rule: Map the governing rule layers before designing any prospecting or marketing tactic
anti_rework_rules.prevents: building a channel, a partnership, or a material set that must be dismantled and its resulting contacts explained

anti_rework_rules.rule: Complete the shared annual training before starting any carrier product module
anti_rework_rules.prevents: blocked or invalidated modules and a retake waiting period that can swallow a carrier's deadline

anti_rework_rules.rule: Obtain the carrier release and dormancy policy in writing before submitting contracting paperwork through an upline
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a contract locked into a hierarchy that cannot be moved for a period the agent never agreed to knowingly

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify ready-to-sell status before spending on leads or booking events for a carrier
anti_rework_rules.prevents: purchased pipeline and committed venue costs for products the agent cannot present, and applications that cannot be paid

anti_rework_rules.rule: Get material classified and approved before printing, posting, or advertising it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: recall, reprint, retraction of published content, and a violation record for a piece that would have passed review

anti_rework_rules.rule: Capture permission and scope into the record system at first contact rather than on paper to be entered later
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unreconstructable files, contacts that cannot be traced to an artifact, and a permission scope nobody can prove

anti_rework_rules.rule: Define the complete-file standard before the season rather than during it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: retroactive file assembly under a response clock, which produces exactly the gaps an auditor looks for

anti_rework_rules.rule: Vet a lead vendor's capture page and verbatim consent language before the first purchase
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unusable batch, inherited complaints, and calls already made against consent that never existed

anti_rework_rules.rule: Version every public asset to a plan year at the moment it is created
anti_rework_rules.prevents: the annual purge becoming an archaeology exercise across racks, partner venues, and old posts

anti_rework_rules.rule: Decide the vulnerable-consumer hard-stop rule before the first appointment where it could apply
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an improvised judgement under family pressure that produces a contested enrollment and a harmed beneficiary

iteration_protocol.trigger: a new plan-year rule set, carrier marketing policy, or regulator bulletin is published
iteration_protocol.action: re-read the affected obligation classes, update the rule map's locators and dates, re-version affected material, and re-brief the practice on what changed

iteration_protocol.trigger: a carrier changes its certification, contracting, or appointment requirements
iteration_protocol.action: re-sequence the certification project by revenue dependence, re-check the contract register, and re-verify the ready-to-sell matrix for that carrier

iteration_protocol.trigger: a complaint, secret-shop finding, or monitored-call finding arrives
iteration_protocol.action: triage the same day, respond factually from the file, correct the beneficiary's situation where possible, and close the root cause into the catalog and the self-monitoring checklist

iteration_protocol.trigger: a lead channel fails, a vendor is suspended, or a venue partnership ends
iteration_protocol.action: quarantine anything already sourced from it, re-balance the mix toward approved sources, and execute the substitution plan recorded for that source

iteration_protocol.trigger: a sampled file review finds missing required elements at a rate above the practice's own threshold
iteration_protocol.action: identify whether the defect is in intake design or in seasonal shortcuts, change the capture step, and re-sample after the change

iteration_protocol.trigger: the practice adds a state, a carrier, or a product line
iteration_protocol.action: extend the licence and continuing-education calendar, add the contracting and certification path, and widen the ready-to-sell matrix before any activity in the new territory

iteration_protocol.trigger: a privacy incident, a lost device, or a near-miss occurs
iteration_protocol.action: run the written response path, scope what data was involved, tighten the handling control that failed, and record the change in the remediation log

iteration_protocol.trigger: a content audit finds dated plan-specific material still published or in circulation
iteration_protocol.action: purge or re-version it the same day, add the distribution point to the inventory, and re-run the purge across every channel and partner venue
